title_sq: Tek Univers City, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Perfekte, Gati Per Banim!!

title_en: At Univers City, 2+1 apartment for sale, with perfect floor plan, ready for habitation!!
description_en: At Univers City, 2+1 apartment for sale, with perfect floor plan, ready for habitation!!! The apartment is located on the 1st residential floor of a newly completed 8-story building and is ready for occupancy. The apartment has a total area of ​​94.57 m2, a net area of ​​82.48 m2 and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and 2 balconies. The orientation of the property is from East and West. The residential complex where this apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities offering peace, security, ease and comfort of a small town, having the luxury of being close to 10 minutes away from the center of the capital and 2 minutes from QTU. The residence offers a public school and kindergarten, 24/7 security, health center, commercial service unit, central park, sports areas, children's playgrounds, parking spaces.
